svg.title: Interlacing patterns 1/1, 2/2 and 3/3
svg.desc: Part of the unrolled mandrel (circumference horizontal, axis vertical) at α = 45° for 12 carriers. Over/under at every crossing is computed from the machine's gear sides: the yarn of the outer carrier lies on top.
